_comment: 世界演出 (DECISIONS「世界演出」): the small things the map shows about what happens on it. Presentation only: nothing here changes a rule, a position, a door's state or what is saved. All of it is off with the feel's world_fx_ms at 0 (the suites); the times below are shares of it.

weather._comment: Rain: falls outdoors while the sky (SkyState, DECISIONS「天气」) is at `from_level` or above (4: 天空中乌云密布), coming and going over fade_seconds. regions: what falls in a region, by its id (none: nothing — the desert beyond the pass, the land of the dead); default: any other. A map's own voxel config may say "weather": false (a cave under the open sky's light). kinds: count the drops about the camera at the heaviest, size a drop's box, colour / alpha, fall its speed (units a second), wind how far it slants (times the map's guiding wind, else `drift`), height where drops begin, radius how far about what the camera looks at they fall; rings: the marks drops leave on the ground (count, size, seconds each lasts). low_quality: the share of the drops on 画质 低. No snow: ES2 has none and no place is snowed on for its name (美术规划 §1).

door._comment: A door swings on its hinge as it opens and shuts (its leaf was there or gone before): `swing` how far (radians), `seconds` how long (shares of world_fx_ms). A door whose look has its own open form (layout door_looks `open`) changes as before.

pickup._comment: A thing taken from the ground by the player (it was within `reach` units of them as it went) flies up to their hand and is gone: rise how high its arc goes, seconds how long (shares of world_fx_ms).

startle._comment: One whose alert mark comes up (进门一起上: it has noticed the player) starts: a small hop of `hop` units, the mark popping from `pop` times its size, over `seconds` (shares of world_fx_ms).

wade._comment: One walking through shallow water (ground kinds `kinds`) throws up a splash every `stride` units: `drops` small blocks of `colour` flung up `rise` units and out `spread`, over `seconds` (shares of world_fx_ms).
